free_tier.stated: 50 GiB storage, 250 MB RAM, 200 GiB torrent traffic, 1 Gbps, for 30 days, free. 'Free Seedbox Trial 30 Days — FREE!!!! Free like Free Speech! — 50 GiB Storage'.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: Retention: 30-day trial only. The binding clause.

egress.terms: Included in the 200 GiB torrent traffic allowance; no per-GB charge stated.

tooling: RTorrent + ruTorrent/Deluge/qBittorrent web UI, SSH, SFTP, Docker rootless, Jellyfin media stack, WireGuard/OpenVPN. SFTP is the storage transport. Usable by rclone's `sftp` backend.
chaining: Real but weak: 50 GiB x N accounts, and each trial is 30 days, so the chain has to be re-established monthly. Not a storage tier; a way to test throughput before buying the EUR 1.99/mo 230 GiB plan.
limits_note: Per-object-cap: none stated. Request-rate: n/a (SSH). Retention: 30-day trial only. The binding clause. Traffic: 200 GiB/month.
